seo.title: Unified inbox for WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and web chat | Steps AI
seo.description: See every customer conversation from every agent and channel in one inbox. Filter, take over from the AI and reply as your team.

hero.title: Every customer conversation in one inbox.
hero.body: Website chats, WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger arrive in one place, from every agent you run. Your AI agent answers first, and your team takes over when a person is needed.
hero.reassurance: One inbox for every channel. Filters that find what needs you. Your team replies in the same thread.

steps.title: From AI answer to human reply.
steps.intro: The inbox is where your team sees what the agent did and steps in when it matters.

items.title: Conversations arrive from every channel
items.body: Each conversation shows which agent and channel it came from, so your team knows the context straight away.

items.title: Filter to what needs a person
items.body: Filter by agent or channel, and by unread, starred or live conversations, to find the ones that need attention.

items.title: Take over from the agent
items.body: When a customer asks for a person, a team member claims the conversation and continues it with the full history.

items.title: Reply and resolve
items.body: Your team replies in the same thread, then resolves the handoff. The conversation stays in the inbox for later.

features.title: What you can do in the inbox.
features.intro: Built for the people who look after your customers every day.

items.title: See every agent in one place
items.body: The account inbox shows conversations from all your agents. Each agent also has its own conversation view.

items.title: Filter by channel and agent
items.body: Narrow the list to one channel or one agent when you need to focus.

items.title: Star and track unread
items.body: Star important conversations and keep track of what has not been read yet.

items.title: Claim a live request
items.body: When the agent hands over, a team member claims the conversation so customers are not answered twice.

items.title: See the customer next to the chat
items.body: Customer details from your CRM sit beside the conversation.

items.title: Work on mobile
items.body: The inbox and conversations work on a phone, with stacked panels and a back button.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: A team member can reply once they have claimed the conversation and it is assigned to them.
Human handoff starts from the Starter plan.

items.q: Can my team reply to customers from the inbox?
items.a: Yes. A team member claims the conversation, replies in the same thread and resolves the handoff when it is done.

items.q: Does the AI keep replying after my team takes over?
items.a: Once a person has taken over, the conversation is with your team until the handoff is resolved.

items.q: Can I see conversations for just one agent?
items.a: Yes. Filter the account inbox by agent, or open the agent’s own conversation view.

items.label: CRM
items.body: See customer records and tickets next to every conversation.

items.label: Agent skills
items.body: Set when the agent hands over to a person.

items.label: Analytics
items.body: See what customers ask and when they message.

cta.title: See the unified inbox with your own business in mind.
cta.body: Book a demo and we will walk through it using your own information and channels.
